title: Day 8: The Fever
body: Sarah’s skin is cold. Not "chilly," but like a piece of meat in a freezer. Her fever is so high the thermometer shattered, yet she says she's freezing. She asked me to tell her a story about the beach, but I couldn't remember what the ocean looks like. All I can see when I close my eyes is that pale thing in the hallway. I think I’m starting to cough
